issues.where: whole first frame, especially the right third
issues.what: the opening frame is mostly grey-on-grey: a flat cliff face takes the right third and the giant spires are pale against a pale storm sky, so at phone size in a feed the first read is 'grey seascape' rather than 'giant bones rising from the sea'; nothing has strong contrast or a single focal point
issues.fix: open on a frame where one spire is silhouetted against a brighter break in the cloud, or push contrast and add a warm or bright accent; cut or shorten the cliff wipe so the spires are framed from frame 1

issues.fix: put the creature against a lighter patch of sky or darken its silhouette and bring it closer so its wing shape reads at thumbnail size

issues.what: the frame is a wide 16:9 landscape; in a vertical phone feed it plays as a thin strip, which shrinks the spires and the flock to specks and weakens the stop

issues.where: the motion across the ten frames
